Why Anatomy Matters

Learning outcome: Explain how anatomy helps prevent false alarms, direct the search and support dignity.

The operator is not a radiographer and does not diagnose disease. Anatomy is used to account for normal structures so that unexplained anomalies can be assessed calmly and appropriately. An anomaly is a feature that remains unexplained after normal anatomy has been considered. Select each panel to explore the operator’s purpose.
